commit_date = 2026-08-31
vendored    = 2026-09-01 (into unirl/models/leo2/vendor/gen_ar/)

The vendored runtime contains the upstream hymm/ and processors/ source trees,
plus the two inference-time submodules below. Model weights, generation
configuration, tokenizer/VAE assets, datasets, tests, jobs, and .git metadata
are intentionally external to this package.

Submodules pinned by the upstream commit:
  deps/hy_parallelism = a2fb81523b4c35563d7129ff47e5a0955f77d204
  deps/IndexKits      = d83299da6b0efdd87c4e0387d603e5f3721210ce

Dependency snapshot provenance:
  deps/IndexKits was exported exactly from d83299da6b0efdd87c4e0387d603e5f3721210ce.
  deps/hy_parallelism was copied from the flattened source tree at
  https://git.woa.com/bowenping/gen-ar.git commit
  e6b8b5934ce2e57d0ea4abbff8b8d1179fdc49c3; its package version is 1.1.12.
  The original a2fb815 gitlink repository was unavailable during vendoring, so
  that SHA could not be independently verified. Replace this snapshot when the
  pinned repository becomes available.

Not vendored: deps/AngelPTM and deps/VLMEvalKit. They are not imported by the
Leo2 inference bootstrap.

Local integration:
  - unirl.models.leo2.bundle inserts this directory and the two dependency
    roots into sys.path, preserving hymm's upstream absolute imports.
  - unirl.models.leo2.config resolves the default hymm root and Leo2 YAML from
    this tree. User-supplied paths continue to override those defaults.
  - hymm/models/basic/rope_cache.py carries UniRL's exact input-signature cache
    key, explicit reset, and hit/miss counters.
  - hymm/models/diffusion/leo_cache.py plus the Leo model/pipeline integration
    carry UniRL's request-scoped Diffusers-style first-block inference cache.

To re-vendor: export the source commit and IndexKits commit above, obtain the
hy_parallelism gitlink source (or document its replacement), replace this tree
without .git metadata, then update this file and rerun the Leo2 bootstrap smoke.
